declared difference (issue #1035 review R3): the rc/ climb ends at the root of the servlet's own module. A gradle
project script (Kotlin here; Groovy build.gradle and settings.gradle too) is looked at for its own rc/ and ends
the climb, so the rc/ of the directory above (m/rc, another module's) is never read: no evidence in the rows.
